page_title: CEL 2-0 RSO | Celta Vigo v Real Sociedad 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Real Sociedad earn a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Borja Iglesias trots off the pitch and is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) for Oscar Mingueza.
87' A corner kick by Real Sociedad is thwarted by the well prepared Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo).
84' Here is a change. Alfonso Gonzalez is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo).
83' The substitution is prepared. Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Brais Mendez.
83' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.

83' Alex Remiro makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the goal.
78' The referee blows his whistle as Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in his challenge. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
77' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.

75' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets no option but to blow his whistle. Free kick. Real Sociedad will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
74' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
73' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Pablo Duran is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
72' Substitution. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) replaces Sergio Carreira.
71' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
70' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
66' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) heads on.
66' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mateo Busquets blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Celta Vigo.
64' Mikel Oyarzabal will be replaced by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
61' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
60' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad). It's a free kick to Celta Vigo in a dangerous position.
57' The linesman raises his flag. Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is adjudged offside.
57' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
57' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
56' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
52' The goal by Celta Vigo is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
52' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Celta Vigo players aren’t happy.

50' GOAL! Superb work from Fran Beltran, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo), who beats Alex Remiro with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
48' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' The game is over for Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad). Jon Martin comes on for the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Imanol Alguacil gives a chance to Sheraldo Becker and Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Imanol Alguacil decided to make a change. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is replaced by Orri Oskarsson.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+1' 2 - 0 Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Alfonso Gonzalez, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
41' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) makes a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
40' 1 - 0 Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) produces a remarkable finish after hitting a wonderful first-time shot towards goal from long range and the ball flies inside the right post!
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
38' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
37' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. It's a throw-in for Celta Vigo.
31' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move. Real Sociedad have been awarded a free kick.

28' Mateo Busquets interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad). Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier. A free kick has been awarded to Celta Vigo.
27' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

26' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
23' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
20' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
14' Dangerous play by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad). Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo win a free kick.
14' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) brings an opponent down and Mateo Busquets interrupts the game. It's a free kick to Celta Vigo, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
13' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Real Sociedad have a free kick.
11' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
7' Poor challenge! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is penalised for tripping and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Real Sociedad.
6' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.

5' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
3' Wonderful movement by Real Sociedad. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
3' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.

1' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.

1' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Real Sociedad will kick the game off.
Mateo Busquets will officiate today.
